dashboard.title: Vobs Playground

dashboard.openedSSR: Opened the SSR and hydration examples.

data.description: Storage, Preferences and Dict share the same app-level plugin/context model.

data.defaultStorageValue: Stored in the browser localStorage backend
data.preferencesDescription: Schema validation, reactive values and reset/save operations.
data.dictionaryDescription: Static dictionary data is exposed through a named query with reactive loading/error state.
data.routerActionsDescription: Trigger action and fetcher requests and inspect them in DevTools Router.

resource.name: Name
resource.scenarioDescription: Loading, empty, error, cancellation, retry, server pagination and writes.

forms.title: Forms and validation
forms.description: Field-level signals, validation rules, touched state, server errors and submit lifecycle.
forms.validatedDescription: Blur a field to see field-level errors; submit runs validateAll().
forms.stateDescription: All values below come from the form API.
forms.name: Name
forms.fillAndSubmit: Fill in the form and submit to run validation.

components.title: UI component gallery
components.emptyDescription: Nothing to display in this branch.
components.errorDescription: The action failed safely and the page remains usable.
components.transitionDescription: This alert enters and leaves through the transition package.
components.formDescription: The UI primitives remain controlled by signals.
components.tabsDescription: These are standalone components and do not require a router.
components.tabsContent: Tabs manage local selection and render only the active panel.
components.workbenchDescription: FileTree, EditorTabs and ActivityRail compose into IDE-like surfaces.
components.chatDescription: A reusable composer with model and tool slots.
components.dialogContent: This is a controlled dialog. Close it with the button or backdrop.
components.drawerContent: Drawer content is mounted through the same controlled open state.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description: Slider captcha UI example using a local mock challenge; HTTP, token and server-side risk control stay with the application.
captcha.instructions: Drag the puzzle piece to the gap. The component collects the drag trail and optional device signals, then passes them to the application layer.
captcha.security: The frontend only produces behavioral evidence; the server must perform the final validation of the challenge, trail and token.
captcha.expired: Captcha expired. Please get a new one.
captcha.trailError: The drag trail is invalid. Hold the slider and drag naturally, then try again.
captcha.positionError: The slider position is incorrect. Drag it to the gap.

async.title: Async workbench
async.description: Queue, HTTP, Upload, Sync, Notification and Logger working together with real cancellation/lifecycle APIs.
async.httpDescription: Run a real @vobs/http request and inspect it in DevTools Network.
async.queueDescription: Priority scheduling, concurrency and reactive task state.
async.taskFailed: Demo task failed once; retry it to recover.
async.uploadDescription: Upload delegates transport, progress and retry behavior to @vobs/http.
async.chooseFile: Choose a file to send through the upload context.
async.syncDescription: This local transport acknowledges the request and returns a new cursor; storage and queue are injected from their plugins.
async.noSync: No sync cycle has run yet.
async.inspectDescription: The devtoolsPlugin is enabled with window.__VOBS_DEVTOOLS__. Open the browser console to inspect signals, effects and component ownership.

runtime.title: Core runtime
runtime.description: Small, observable examples of Vobs signals, ownership and rendering primitives.
runtime.stateDescription: State is mutable through .value; memo derives and caches a value until its dependencies change.
runtime.effectDescription: Changing the dependency runs cleanup first, then the effect again.
runtime.ownerDescription: Owners scope effects and cleanups. Dispose the child owner to release its resources.
runtime.refDescription: A ref exposes the mounted host node without querying the document.
runtime.refReady: Ref is attached to the input.
runtime.idDescription: createId generates owner-scoped IDs suitable for accessible label/control relationships.
runtime.asyncDescription: Resolve or reject a deferred promise and observe loading, success and fallback branches.
runtime.profilerDescription: Profiler reports mount/update phase and render duration while keeping callbacks isolated.
runtime.listDescription: insertList reconciles DOM nodes by key: additions, removals and reordering reuse existing nodes whenever possible.
runtime.templateDescription: createTemplate parses an HTML string into an inert template; cloneTemplate copies its content in O(1).

auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Authenticate to access protected playground routes.
auth.accountDescription: Use any non-empty username. Use admin to preview an elevated role.
auth.jwtConsoleDescription: Demonstrates access token issuance, expiry countdown, single-flight refresh and 401 replay.
auth.jwtHint: 'Call directly' returns 401 once the token expires; 'Call with 401 replay' refreshes the token first and then replays the request.

config.configDescription: Fill in the Alipay Open Platform application configuration (sandbox or production).
config.savedDescription: This is a demo page. In production, store configuration in server-side environment variables.
